# opnsense_acmeclient_account (Resource)

Manages an ACME Client account in the OPNsense os-acme-client plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_acmeclient_account" "staging" {
  name  = "letsencrypt-staging"
  email = "admin@example.com"
  ca    = "letsencrypt_test"
}

resource "opnsense_acmeclient_account" "production" {
  name  = "letsencrypt-production"
  email = "admin@example.com"
  ca    = "letsencrypt"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Contact email address registered with the ACME CA.
- `name` (String) Display name for the ACME account.

### Optional

- `account_key` (String, Sensitive) ACME account private key. Managed by OPNsense when omitted; may be imported or read back from the API.
- `ca` (String) Certificate authority identifier (e.g. `letsencrypt`, `letsencrypt_test`, `zerossl`). Defaults to `letsencrypt`.
- `custom_ca` (String) Custom ACME CA directory URL when `ca` is set to a custom value.
- `description` (String) Optional description for this ACME account.
- `eab_hmac` (String, Sensitive) External Account Binding (EAB) HMAC key, if required by the CA.
- `eab_kid` (String) External Account Binding (EAB) key identifier, if required by the CA.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this ACME account. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACME account.
- `status_code` (String) Last known ACME account status code from OPNsense (read-only).
- `status_last_update` (String) Timestamp of the last ACME account status update (read-only).

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_acmeclient_account using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_acmeclient_account.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_acmeclient_account using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_acmeclient_account.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
